customManagers.description: Track GREMLINS_VERSION in .github/workflows/mutation.yml — gremlins is `go install`-ed at CI runtime, so neither the gomod nor github-actions manager sees it. Renovate cross-references go-gremlins/gremlins's GitHub releases.

Track GOTESTSUM_VERSION in .github/workflows/ci.yml — gotestsum is `go install`-ed at CI runtime to emit the JUnit XML Codecov's Test Analytics ingests, so neither the gomod nor github-actions manager sees it (the install leaves go.mod/go.sum untouched, and it is a `run:` step not a `uses:`). Renovate cross-references gotestyourself/gotestsum's GitHub releases — the repo, not the module path `gotest.tools/gotestsum`, because the datasource is github-releases.

packageRules.description: Indirect gomod deps still get bumped — Go's transitive graph is part of the supply chain.
Gremlins (mutation testing) is pinned as GREMLINS_VERSION in the workflow file, not go.mod — keep it on the chore(ci) cadence so its PR title passes the conventional-title check.

gotestsum (test-output tool) is pinned as GOTESTSUM_VERSION in ci.yml, not go.mod — keep it on the chore(ci) cadence and auto-merge on green CI, mirroring the gremlins rule above. Both CI tools ride the github-actions group.

Hold the Go toolchain at 1.26.x. Go 1.27 enables the jsonv2 GOEXPERIMENT by default, reimplementing encoding/json's Marshal on the v2 engine, which renders invalid UTF-8 as the literal U+FFFD character instead of the \ufffd escape claustrum's reference daemon emits — silently diverging every non-text files.read frame on the wire (inherited_encoding_test.go guards this and fails under 1.27). Allow 1.26.x patch/security bumps; block 1.27+ until the reference daemon's own encoding is confirmed. Matches both the go and toolchain directives (both carry depName go under the gomod manager).
